question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Over the moon
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Extremely happy'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the given idiom 'Over the moon' is- to be very pleased (बहुत प्रसन्न होना)
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• She was over the moon about/with her new bike.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2.**
